labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks when PRs will be enabled for external contributors: a contribution-process question, not a bug or docs error.

body:
Pull requests are currently limited to collaborators, so the way to propose this change is to describe it in an issue first. The contribution rules are in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md).

Naming the broken link and the page it appears on, in an issue, lets a maintainer check it. For general questions about contributing, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the place to ask.

A related earlier request is #4029.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
